verdict.rationale: Google Authenticator's only documented sync goes through signing in to a Google Account. Nothing in the evidence describes a self-hostable sync server. Using the app without an account, or moving codes by QR export, keeps secrets local, but those are adjacent workarounds, not a self-hosted sync capability.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can self-host the sync server on my own infrastructure and keep every secret inside my perimeter
